name: trimester
title: Trimester
description: A gentian-violet midwife theme built around the card pregnancy wheel: a muslin disc with forty week ticks and three trimester arcs, the phone and Book link in its hub, and an arrow at week forty pointing to the on-call number.

tokens.--font-body: all text: a flared humanist sans from the system (Optima, Candara or a near match)
tokens.--text-s: small text: labels, dates, the masthead Book button, the footer, step and list numbers
tokens.--text-l: the site name, ledes, list titles, small headings, the emergency number beside the wheel, footer phone numbers
tokens.--text-rim: the week figures round the wheel's rim (a share of the wheel's width)
tokens.--color-text: muslin text on the violet ground: page titles, the menu, the footer
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the violet ground: ledes, labels, the footer, the tick row above the footer, menu hover lines, the first arc of the mark beside the site name
tokens.--color-accent: lavender on the violet ground: the arrow from week forty to the emergency line, the current menu item, focus rings, the second arc of the mark beside the site name
tokens.--color-panel: the muslin of the wheel, the reading panels and the emergency label; the masthead Book button, the 40 on the pointer, and the text on violet buttons
tokens.--color-panel-ink: uniform-navy ink on muslin: text, the week ticks and figures, the ring round the hub, the masthead Book button's text
tokens.--color-panel-muted: secondary navy text on muslin: summaries, dates, table headings, quotes, the hub and emergency labels, the rule in page text
tokens.--color-link: violet on muslin: links, the third trimester arc (the first two are paler mixes of it), the pointer at week forty, the hub's Book button, step and list numbers, the top edge of the Before-your-visit slip
tokens.--color-hub: the wheel's inner disc and the Before-your-visit slip
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines between list items, table rows and steps
tokens.--color-shadow: the soft shadow that lifts the wheel, the hub and the reading panels off the ground
tokens.--wheel-size: the wheel's diameter when there is room for it
tokens.--gutter: the side margin of the page and the side padding of the reading panels
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the reading panels and the Before-your-visit slip
tokens.--radius-s: small corner rounding: buttons, the emergency label, tags, code
tokens.--line-bold: thick lines: the current menu item, focus rings, quote bars, the tick before page headings
